reviews.name: Jayson L.
reviews.text: Our lender was amazing very professional and worked harder than any lender i have ever worked i am a disabled vetran who does not have the best credit. I have bean turned down 4 or 5 times i didnt even want to apply any more until kris said he could get it done and he did amazing man he made my family's dreams come true thanks kris syevens.

reviews.name: Sam N.
reviews.text: Great communicator and understands the business to help clients. Kris took the time to reply and keep me informed throughout the process. Many thanks Kris!

reviews.name: Jeremy D.
reviews.text: I was so fortunate to have Kris working for us. He was a tremendous asset when dealing with the VA. He knew exactly what paperwork was necessary and was always helpful whenever we needed assistance or had questions. I highly recommend him.

reviews.name: Jose G.
reviews.text: Very pleasing experience. He made the process very smooth helping me with any questions or concerns that I had. I will highly recommend him to my friends and family. He was always available at all times and was able to help me tremendously obtaining my first house.

reviews.name: Mhenry0306
reviews.text: To begin, my case was probably

. I had many financial issues and wanted to refinance my home. I spoke with Mr. Syevens and he was very honest and upfront. He gave me the truth about my situation and no false hope. He explained that it would be difficult, but he was dedicated to assist me to be best of his ability. I wanted to give up and quit at one point, but Mr. Syevens refuse to give up on me. We started working together in October of 2015. I closed in March of 2016. Needless to say I had a difficult case, and every case is different, but I said all this to say, there is no one more dedicated to helping you meet your needs. Mr. Syevens went beyond my expectations and more. I would recommend his service and expertise to any one in need of mortgage assistance. 100%...........

reviews.name: Nataly V.
reviews.text: Kris was amazing through the whole process of buying our first home. He answered all of our questions, even if we asked them a few times. My husband and I cannot thank him enough for being there for us for the entire process. Thank you for your hard work and making our Dream come true!

reviews.name: Raveen D.
reviews.text: Kris was with me all the way. He was very responsive, day and night, over the weekends too. We would email, text and phone call, whatever was convenient for me. He made sure I had all the information I needed to be informed and even explained the basic principles and terms of mortgages for me. I would recommend him to anyone and plan to use him again for another mortgage in the near future. He was definitely on my side and made this a very painless and positive experience.
